subject: general
question: Which of the following represents non-uniform linear velocity?

options.text: A ball rolling at uniform rate
A body moving in a straight line at fixed speed
A car moving at constant speed

solution:
The correct answer is __**A train starting from rest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Non-uniform linear velocity** occurs when an object travels in a **straight line** but its **speed changes** over time, or when its **direction changes** while moving. In the case of **linear motion**, the direction remains constant, so non-uniformity arises specifically from a **change in magnitude** (speed).
 
• **A train starting from rest** implies that its initial **velocity** is **zero**. As the train begins to move, it must **accelerate** to gain speed. Because the **magnitude** of its velocity is increasing from **0 m/s** to a higher value, the velocity is not constant. ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• **A ball rolling at a uniform rate** suggests that the ball is covering **equal distances in equal intervals of time**. If it is rolling in a single direction, both its **speed** and **direction** are constant, representing **uniform velocity**. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
